case.title: Add ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute to generated code.
case.head: a0aa5ab2de7f5a669d97e37184a89034c1de82b6

requirements.text: Generated MessagePack code should be decorated with ExcludeFromCodeCoverage so that it does not distort coverage results.
requirements.quote: I would like all generated code to be decorated with ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute.

requirements.text: A configuration setting for the behavior is optional; always-on behavior is acceptable.
requirements.quote: I do not feel like a setting is needed, but setting would be fine to have too.

requirements.text: The requested coverage applies to every emitted generated type, including generated nested resolver helpers, rather than merely requiring one attribute somewhere in each generated file.

added: All generated formatters and resolvers are decorated with `[ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]`, so generated code does not skew code coverage reports.
The attribute is only emitted for targets where it is available (not `netstandard2.0` or .NET Framework).
